name: lwb
description: A generic SDLC gate plugin, set up here as a safe minimal skeleton: ships one no-op rule, lwb_version, which allows every event and reports the plugin's version. Policy is per-rule off/warn/deny, fails open (a missing or broken policy file never blocks a dispatch), and the engine is pure — see core/lwb_core/engine.py. BuildCraft's real stage/role/gate rules are built in a later session.
